sourceBasis.title: Heathrow Low Visibility Operations OSI052
sourceBasis.relevance: Safeguarding and LVP are separate stages; safeguarding precedes LVP and may continue after LVP cancellation. Its cancellation is separately confirmed.

sourceBasis.title: NATS low-visibility procedures explanation
sourceBasis.relevance: General context for measured visibility, ATC procedures and ILS protection; no specific Heathrow incident or operational training validation claimed.

learningObjective: In this condensed practice exercise, use the reports to distinguish low-visibility procedures, safeguarding and departure clearance.

metadata.note: Independently retimed for three scored checkpoints; not operational response times or a one-hour playback.

timingAndAuthorityBoundaries.learnerFacingBoundary: Generic aircraft; authored flight paths, elapsed times and report delays. No recovered flight-data trajectory, operational clearance or performance validation. Fog attenuation, event timings and the flight-specific hold are authored. No measured visibility, RVR, operational minima, capacity forecast or current Heathrow procedure compliance is asserted. This short scored practice is separate from the full-hour demonstration. Its timing is fictional.
timingAndAuthorityBoundaries.separateHourDemonstration: fog_visibility remains 3600 seconds and is not a scored lesson.
timingAndAuthorityBoundaries.aircraftPosition: Stationary mapped Terminal 3 apron; no flight or taxi movement added.
